title: Felix and the Parish
author: K. M. Okafor
blurb: Sebastian Quintana, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
